description.text: Public Housing Rent Reduction for First Responders Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

bill.title: Public Housing Rent Reduction for First Responders Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill amends the U.S. Housing Act to set rent in public housing for families with full‑time police officers, firefighters, or emergency medical technicians at the higher of 15% of adjusted monthly income or 5% of monthly income. It applies to units under the Act and to such full‑time public employees.

impact.summary: This bill cuts rents in public housing for families including a full‑time police officer, firefighter, or EMT. Rent becomes the greater of 15% of monthly adjusted income or 5% of monthly income, and public housing agencies verify federal, state, local, or tribal employment.
